Rust is a general-purpose programming language emphasizing performance, type safety, and concurrency. It enforces memory safety without a garbage collector.

History

Rust began as a personal project of Graydon Hoare in 2006. Mozilla sponsored it from 2009 and announced it in 2010. The first stable release came in 2015.

Syntax

The syntax is similar to C and C++.

fn main() { println!("hi"); }
